subject.title: Feature: Add /models test-fallback command to verify fallback chain

question: Should OpenClaw add a dedicated `/models test-fallback` command now, or fold fallback-chain verification into the broader configured-model health and staged model migration work?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested command adds a new live provider/auth diagnostic surface that overlaps open feature requests for `models status --probe --all` and staged model migration.

options.title: Sponsor narrow fallback probe
options.body: Add a first-class command that intentionally starts at configured fallback candidates, supports first/all modes, and reports which fallback model responded while reusing runtime fallback/auth resolution.

options.title: Fold into broader model health
options.body: Track the behavior under configured-model health checks or staged migration so users get one canonical diagnostic path instead of parallel commands.

options.title: Defer core command
options.body: Leave current status/auth probes and fallback management unchanged until maintainers choose a broader model migration UX.

recommendation.title: Sponsor narrow fallback probe
recommendation.body: Add a first-class command that intentionally starts at configured fallback candidates, supports first/all modes, and reports which fallback model responded while reusing runtime fallback/auth resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the clearest product-scope review on this issue and has adjacent history in fallback/status behavior.
